data.narrative:
Aalyria, a Series B-stage space and aerospace company founded by Chris Taylor, has a post-money valuation of $1.3B following $130M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis incorporates a comparable universe of 5 public-sector peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage range, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, and Skyryse.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median valuation across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Sierra Space at $8.0B, and Skyryse at $1.1B) produces a median of $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data. These two methods triangulate to a median valuation of $2.2B, with a defensible range between $1.7B and $2.8B.

Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations ($1.1B–$8.0B spread) and the stage heterogeneity within the peer set, which spans Series B and Series C. Conviction in any point estimate remains moderate without access to Aalyria's revenue metrics or detailed operational milestones relative to comparables.
